name: Scale AI
h1: Scale AI ARR: $1B+ After the Meta Deal Reset.
intro: Scale AI rode the data-labeling boom to ~$2B of revenue, sold half of itself to Meta, and then watched 2026 guidance get cut from $4B to just over $1B as its biggest AI-lab customers walked. Every reported revenue, valuation and guidance number is collected below, each traced back to a public source.

modelTitle: How Data Labeling Became a $2B Business.
modelParagraphs: Scale sells the human side of AI: data labeling and RLHF for model training, expert evaluations, plus government and enterprise AI applications. Revenue grew from $290M in 2022 to ~$2B in 2025 as every frontier lab became a customer — and its list price model is engagement-based, with large multi-year contracts for training data pipelines and evaluation.

The Meta deal inverted the business. Meta's $14.3B purchase of a 49% non-voting stake in June 2025 — which also took CEO Alexandr Wang to Meta — made Scale's rivals its owner's rivals. OpenAI and Google pulled back their business, and 2026 guidance was cut from a projected $4B to just over $1B, the steepest reversal reported for the company. Scale has since leaned on enterprise and government contracts and new business lines, with third-party snapshots suggesting a run rate recovering toward ~$2B annualized by June 2026.

faqs.q: What Is Scale AI's ARR in 2026?
faqs.a: Scale AI's 2026 revenue guidance is just over $1 billion, down from earlier projections of $4B for 2026. In 2025 the company generated an estimated ~$2B of revenue. Third-party snapshots suggest the run rate recovered toward ~$2B annualized by mid-2026.

faqs.q: Why Did Scale AI's 2026 Guidance Get Cut?
faqs.a: The Meta deal. When Meta bought a 49% stake for $14.3B in June 2025, Scale's largest AI-lab customers — OpenAI and Google among them — pulled back business over vendor-independence concerns. The resulting reset took 2026 guidance from $4B to $1B+.

faqs.q: What Did Meta Pay for Scale AI?
faqs.a: $14.3 billion for a 49% non-voting stake, valuing Scale at $29 billion — more than double its $13.8B May 2024 mark. Meta also hired CEO Alexandr Wang to lead its superintelligence unit; Scale continued as an independent company under new CEO Jason Droege.

faqs.q: How Does Scale AI Make Money?
faqs.a: Primarily data labeling and RLHF services sold to AI labs under engagement-based contracts, plus enterprise and government AI applications and model evaluation services. The data engine for autonomous vehicles was the original business.

faqs.q: How Fast Did Scale AI Grow?
faqs.a: Revenue roughly tripled from $290M in 2022 to $870M in 2024, then reached an estimated ~$2B in 2025. The 2026 guidance reset to $1B+ marks the first contraction in the company's reported trajectory.
